patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layout for hero and feature sections, where the left column contains primary text and CTAs, and the right column often contains a code example or supporting visual.
Prominent, large, dark sans-serif headings are used to introduce each major section, creating clear visual breaks and hierarchy.
A limited, high-contrast palette of white backgrounds, dark grey text, and bright blue and yellow accents for interactive elements (buttons, links, highlights).
The primary navigation bar transforms from a taller, more spacious initial state to a more compact, sticky state with a subtle background on scroll, maintaining visibility and saving vertical space.
Dedicated social proof section featuring a grid of well-known company logos, clearly communicating enterprise adoption and trust.

technique_notes: The site uses a responsive header that transitions from a taller, transparent state to a shorter, sticky state with a solid background and reduced logo size upon scrolling past the initial hero section.
Content sections are presented with generous vertical spacing, using a clean, minimal layout with a primary text column and a secondary column for code examples or supporting information.
Code examples are visually distinct, presented within a bordered block with a light background and syntax highlighting, making them easy to read and differentiate from body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by standard-sized body text and distinct monospaced code text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons, input fields, and code block containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section has significant vertical padding, while content sections maintain a comfortable reading rhythm with clear separation.

standout: The site's standout feature is its confident, developer-centric presentation, effectively blending clear, concise marketing language with prominent, well-formatted code examples directly in the hero and feature sections. This immediately communicates technical depth and practical utility, appealing directly to a technically proficient audience.
